name: reqable-cli
description: Command-line front end for Reqable's local capture API: list, inspect, export and replay captured traffic without registering an MCP server.

scripts.check: npm test && node test/e2e.mjs && node test/e2e-extra.mjs

reqable.note: The Reqable release line this build was written against. src/reqable.js holds the same values as SUPPORTED_REQABLE and VERIFIED_REQABLE, and test/unit.test.mjs fails if the two disagree.
